name: National Scholarship Portal — Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Central government scholarship for students belonging to Scheduled Caste category studying in Classes 9 and 10. Covers tuition fees and maintenance allowance. Administered through the National Scholarship Portal.

criteria.notes: Student must be studying in a government or government-aided school.

application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal at scholarships.gov.in
Log in and select 'Fresh Application'
Fill in personal, academic, and bank details
Upload scanned copies of required documents
Submit and note your Application Reference Number
Get application verified by school/institute
Track status on the portal

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
description: Department of Science & Technology scholarship for students who secured top 1% marks in Class 12 board exams and are pursuing Bachelor's or Master's in Natural and Basic Sciences. Provides ₹80,000 per year plus mentorship.

criteria.notes: Must be in top 1% of respective board exam. Must be pursuing BSc/BS/MSc/MS/Int-MSc in Natural Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics, or related disciplines. Not applicable for engineering or medicine.

documents: Class 12 marksheet showing top 1% rank or proof of top 1% in board
Self-declaration about not availing any other DST scholarship
application_steps: Visit the official INSPIRE portal at online-inspire.gov.in
Register with your email and create a password
Complete your academic profile and upload documents
Submit the application before the closing date
Your institution must provide online verification
Track status through the portal dashboard

name: Eklavya Scholarship — Maharashtra Tribal Development Department
description: State scholarship for Scheduled Tribe students in Maharashtra studying in Classes 5 to 12 and in higher education. Provides stipend, book allowance, and hostel assistance for eligible tribal students.

criteria.notes: Student must be domiciled in Maharashtra. Tribe must be listed in Maharashtra ST schedule.

documents: Caste certificate (ST) issued by Maharashtra authority
application_steps: Visit the Maharashtra Mahadblt portal at mahadblt.maharashtra.gov.in
Register or log in with your Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Select the Eklavya Scholarship scheme
Fill in personal, academic, and caste details
Upload all required documents
Submit and collect the acknowledgement receipt
Verification will be done by the Tribal Development Officer

name: PM YASASVI — Pre & Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC/EBC/DNT Students
description: Prime Minister's Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India. Provides scholarships to OBC, EBC (Economically Backward Class), and DNT (De-notified Tribes) students studying in Classes 9 to 12 and in higher education. Administered via NTA entrance test.

criteria.notes: Selection based on PM YASASVI entrance test conducted by NTA. Students must be studying in Class 9 or 11 at the time of exam.

documents: Admit card and scorecard of PM YASASVI entrance test
application_steps: Register at yet.nta.ac.in for the PM YASASVI entrance test
Appear for the entrance test on the scheduled date
After qualifying, apply for the scholarship on scholarships.gov.in
Fill in academic and personal details and upload documents
Submit before the scholarship portal deadline
Verification done by school/institution

name: Google Generation Scholarship — India (Women in Tech)
description: Google scholarship for women students pursuing undergraduate or graduate degrees in Computer Science or related technical fields in India. Selected scholars receive a monetary award and may be invited to a scholars' retreat.

criteria.notes: Applicant must be enrolled full-time in a Bachelor's or Master's programme in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. Strong academic record and demonstrated financial need preferred.

application_steps: Visit buildyourfuture.withgoogle.com and find the Generation Scholarship
Complete the online application form
Write the personal essay as per the provided prompt
Submit two recommendation letters from referees
Upload transcripts and other required documents
Submit by the stated deadline and await results
